question: Show the name and account balance of every customer.
List all part names and their retail prices.
Which orders have a total price above 300000?
sql: SELECT o_orderkey, o_totalprice FROM orders WHERE o_totalprice > 300000;

question: List each nation with the name of its region.
sql: SELECT n.n_name, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey;

question: Show each order's date together with the name of the customer who placed it.
sql: SELECT o.o_orderdate, c.c_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey;

question: Which suppliers are in Germany?
sql: SELECT s.s_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY';

question: List the names of suppliers with the parts they supply and the available quantity.
sql: SELECT s.s_name, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey;

question: Which customers in Europe have placed orders?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.c_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE';

question: Show the ship date and order date of every line item that belongs to an urgent priority order.
sql: SELECT l.l_shipdate, o.o_orderdate FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT';

question: What is the number of orders for each order status?
sql: SELECT o_orderstatus, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY o_orderstatus;

question: What is the total extended price of line items by ship mode?
sql: SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(l_extendedprice) FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_shipmode;

question: How many customers are there in each market segment?
sql: SELECT c_mktsegment, COUNT(*) FROM customer GROUP BY c_mktsegment;

question: What is the average account balance of suppliers in each nation?
sql: SELECT n.n_name, AVG(s.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name;

question: What is the total order value for each customer nation?
sql: SELECT n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name;
